whenToUse: Donations, pledges, tips, top-ups or gift-card values: a few preset amounts, an own amount and optionally one-off or recurring.
Telling the giver what their amount does ("₺250 buys ten new books").
avoidWhen: A price that follows from several choices — use estimator.
Entering an arbitrary money value in a form — use formatted-input (CurrencyInput).
a11y: Frequency and amount are labelled radio groups with one tab stop each; the own-amount field states its minimum and maximum as an error message.
The chosen amount, frequency and impact are a polite live region.
